method: Each PDF was opened and its recommended network map or project list read on 2026-10-14. in_brp_all_ages was checked by joining site/data/north-star/traced.geojson (facility in Separated, Shared, Shared-use Path, Car-free) to DataSF 3psu-pn9h blocks by cnn; 'partial' means some blocks of the extent carry an all-ages line. brp_area names one of the nine deferred areas in notes/bike-network-2026-09/2026-09-29-brp-gap-areas.md, or null. Rows added later the same day (the 2024 draft and the advocacy plans) carry in_brp_all_ages 'unchecked': tools/bike-network/community-plan-bikeways.py grades every block itself, so the field is a reading note, not an input.
